item_short_desc: Rothco’s 9MM Pistol Cleaning Kit is designed to provide a complete solution for maintaining and cleaning your 9mm handgun. This all-inclusive kit features a wool brush, brass brush, and bristle brush to ensure every part of your handgun is cleaned thoroughly. Additionally, it comes with 2 brass rod extensions and a solvent holder with a dauber to assist in achieving precision cleaning.
description: Rothco’s 9MM Pistol Cleaning Kit is designed to provide a complete solution for maintaining and cleaning your 9mm handgun. This all-inclusive kit features a wool brush, brass brush, and bristle brush to ensure every part of your handgun is cleaned thoroughly. Additionally, it comes with 2 brass rod extensions and a solvent holder with a dauber to assist in achieving precision cleaning. The components are carefully crafted for durability, allowing for long-lasting use while maintaining the performance of your firearm. For added convenience, all of the cleaning tools are neatly organized in a compact storage case, making it easy to transport and keep everything in one place. Whether you're a regular user or just need to perform routine maintenance, this cleaning kit offers everything you need to keep your 9mm handgun in optimal condition.
